result.reason: The added language reaches the preferred transition period, rates, 30-day machine-readable data return, and deletion certification, but applies only upon termination and not expiry as required. It is otherwise limited to the requested exit obligations and preserves unrelated commercial terms. Drafting should be improved by integrating the addition as a numbered subsection, capitalizing its opening, and reconciling the existing right to destroy Confidential Information with the mandatory return of Customer Data.
